# Legend of the Red Dragon 4.02

`lord402.zip` is the unmodified public shareware archive used by the deployed Mars Hotel door. Its SHA-256 is `52c0272b691dd3a4fd1294abc40115bf8a22f8c8ce4550c92d392212b6e381c0`. The archive is still published from the [Castle Camelot LORD archive page](https://castlecamelot.sourceforge.net/camelot8.htm) through [Nightfall Games](http://www.nightfallgames.com/files/Programs/lord402.zip). `LORD.DOC` permits the complete archive to be shared in its unmodified shareware form.

`registration.txt` contains the public five-number LORD 4.02 registration used by The Mars Hotel. It was recovered from LORDCFG's read-only display of the registered production `LORD.DAT`, then verified by applying it to a new isolated world created from this exact archive. The file SHA-256 is `c0bb3490125474e8fb3b5663809207a09dc1ec1058bb1b4f71e9a22962b19cba`. The operator explicitly identified this registration as public and authorized its inclusion; the original external publication page for the numbers was not present in the recovered material.

LORD remains copyright Robinson Technologies and Metropolis, Inc. This repository preserves the archive and registration; it does not relicense them.
